name: Antigravity 官方额度
description: T3 额度面板里的 Antigravity 额度由官方 CLI 的 /usage 读取：每个实例用自己的登录，不发消息、不耗 token，不拿 token 直接调接口（T3 0.1.13 起自己不再读，装了它面板里才有）。设置里能看每个实例的读取结果、立即重读、选面板里显示哪些额度。
author: t3-extensions

en.name: Antigravity usage via CLI
en.description: Reads Antigravity limits for T3's usage panel with the official CLI's /usage: own sign-in per instance, no message sent, no tokens spent, no API calls with your token. T3 0.1.13+ shows these limits only with it. Settings show each instance's last read, read again, and pick which limits to show.
